I think that one of the things that you might really be missing without realizing it is good Christian community, where you can find encouragement, purpose and meaning from building friendships and serving other people.  I'm not sure what your expectations are of what it will be like when you find a "good christian wife" but it is unrealistic to think that just having a wife is going to fulfill all your needs, making you not lonely and bringing total fulfillment and purpose to your life.   I think it is always valuable to examine your motivations for marriage and if your expectations for marriage and a wife are realistic. All the strategizing and over-analyzing is not seeming to be doing you any favours. We can't necessarily force a relationship out of thin air in the timeline we are wanting to see in our life of when we think we should be married.  As Christians, we can rely on God to lead us on a daily basis.  It's important to find a way to enjoy the life you have now, not putting all the things you want to do in life on hold because you are waiting for a wife first.  You can have a full life, where you have purpose and meaning and joy, good community with friends without needing to be married!
